scenario: An issue carries `agent-ready-claude` and someone also adds `agent-ready-full-claude`, expecting the run to pick whichever route seems most suitable or to fall back to the single-provider route if Copilot is busy.
policyReferences: docs/automation.md § Provider roles and readiness labels
expectedBehavior: Exactly one readiness label may authorise a run, counting the standard, tiered and full-provider labels together. With conflicting readiness labels nothing starts: no triage, assignment or label change happens until a human leaves exactly one label. No route is inferred and no provider is switched automatically.
forbiddenOutcomes: Starting either route while more than one readiness label is present.
Choosing or switching the provider or route automatically instead of leaving it to a human.
Treating a full-provider label as ignorable when counting readiness labels.

assertions.text: Exactly one matching readiness label is required; remove conflicting or stale labels.
Nothing detects provider credits or switches provider automatically.
